name: CHB-MIT Scalp EEG Database: Pediatric Seizure Detection Benchmark
description: The CHB-MIT Scalp EEG Database is an essential open-access biomedical benchmark for automated seizure onset detection. Collected at Boston Children's Hospital and hosted by PhysioNet, the database consists of 664 continuous multi-channel scalp EEG recordings from 22 pediatric subjects (5 males aged 3–22 and 17 females aged 1.5–19) with intractable epileptic seizures. Recorded over 844 total hours using the International 10-20 system of electrode placement sampled at 256 Hz with 16-bit resolution, the dataset contains 198 clinically documented epileptic seizures with precise onset and offset timestamps annotated by clinical neurophysiologists.
